queries.result: Located official Sonipat district Jamabandi/revenue pages, Haryana Web-HALRIS description, HARSAC EODB GIS cadastral application, and an ArcGIS boundary layer for Sonipat MC.

queries.result: Located the official Hindi Sonipat online Jamabandi page and the Hindi district portal; the search did not expose an anonymous parcel-geometry endpoint.

officialSources.observation: Official district page states that Haryana registration, mutation and Jamabandi records can be viewed using owner name, khewat number and khasra numbers, and links to jamabandi.nic.in. This is textual land-record access, not verified parcel geometry.
Official district revenue page states that Sonipat maintains district land records/jamabandies and describes the Sadar Kanungo and record-room functions.
Haryana DITECH says Web-HALRIS is implemented in all 143 tehsils and includes Jamabandi, mutation, Khasra Girdawari and registration modules.
HARSAC, a Haryana Government GIS agency, identifies its EODB (Land GIS) application as having land-owner, land-location and cadastral layers. The linked current frontend is https://hsac.org.in/eodb/.

Official ArcGIS REST metadata exposes a Sonipat MC polygon administrative boundary in EPSG:3857 with OBJECTID_12 and administrative name/code fields. It is not a parcel layer and is not retained as a parcel sample.

requests.outcome: Current HARSAC EODB frontend loaded. Its JavaScript configuration points to https://hsac.in/eodb_backend and exposes anonymous-looking land-query routes, but does not itself prove anonymous data access.
Returned {"message":"Authentication required"}; no district schema or geometry returned. No login or credential attempt made.
Returned authentication-required response; no search result or native parcel identity returned.
Returned authentication-required response for the exact WUP point; this is an access limitation, not evidence of an empty map or citywide absence.
ArcGIS metadata returned successfully; layer is an administrative Sonipat MC polygon, not cadastral parcels. CRS is EPSG:3857; supported formats include JSON, GeoJSON and PBF.

registryBasis: A city/district revenue custodian and state land-record system are directly evidenced by official Sonipat and Haryana government pages. The HARSAC EODB application is an official cadastral GIS candidate, but anonymous parcel access was not verified.

sourceCandidate.name: HARSAC EODB / Digital Land Record, Haryana

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Sonipat district revenue records and Haryana-wide Web-HALRIS; HARSAC EODB presents village/cadastral functionality.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: No anonymous parcel response was verified. The exact-point request returned HTTP 401, and the municipal ArcGIS layer inspected is boundary-only.

remainingUncertainty: The official HARSAC backend may require a public session or other access state; its current cadastral schema and parcel geometry could not be observed anonymously. No claim is made about citywide parcel absence.
